description: Original stylized M16 with an attached pump-action Masterkey. Game-space art. The rifle's fire type (3-Round Burst), fire time, damage and its range falloff, ammunition (startAmmo, the magazine and the reserve it is given with, and maxAmmo, the most its reserve holds), reload (reloadTime, with the magazine in at reloadAddTime), raise, first raise, drop, sprint and aim times, zoom FOV and view kick, the swap times, the mode switch and the Masterkey's shot, pump and reload times are MW2's (weapons/mp/m16_shotgun_mp and m16_shotgun_attach_mp). Still Peace's: one reload length (MW2's empty reload is 2359), mag_out_ms (a sound cue), the hip spread, and the Masterkey's first raise, sprint, aim and reserve.
